WITH sold AS (
  SELECT s.format AS store_format, f.sales_line_id, f.net_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN ref_fiscal_calendar p ON p.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND p.fiscal_period = 2
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN p.period_start_date AND p.period_end_date
    AND f.channel_code = 'ST'
    AND s.store_id < 900
    AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
),
refunds AS (
  SELECT sales_line_id, sum(refund_net) AS refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line
  GROUP BY sales_line_id
)
SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, sold.store_format,
       round(100 * coalesce(sum(refunds.refund_net), 0) / sum(sold.net_amount), 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM sold LEFT JOIN refunds ON refunds.sales_line_id = sold.sales_line_id
GROUP BY sold.store_format
ORDER BY CASE sold.store_format WHEN 'Large' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END
